evidence: decorative_mascot: From seg2:start to seg4:end Data hovers beside the chart (seg2:mid, seg3:mid, seg4:start) with his hands on his head or arms out. He fills nothing and causes no change in the column. Only in the hook does he do any work, placing blocks from a ladder.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start to seg3:end show a stacked column titled 'NO TATTOO IS 68% OF THE WHOLE'. The gold accent fills the bottom block, which is the no-tattoo segment, while the line says most tattooed people have more than one. The '10%' and '22%' segments, which make the claim, are dim and unlabeled to the eye. Data stands to the left holding his head and touches nothing.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic share chart was picked and the accent was given by draw order, landing on the no-tattoo segment instead of the story's subject (22% of 32% with multiple tattoos). The mascot was placed as a reaction, not as an agent.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the 32% tattooed people as a group, and inside it make 22 of 32 visibly carry several tattoos against 10 with one, for example Data inking a second and third mark onto the majority of figures. Give the gold accent only to 'more than one', and give every label ink-contrast text.
